label: PF Backlog 541
title: C9: RAG/Document guardrail + trust levels (untrusted content can never gain authority)
body:
## Problem / why
Retrieved/external content is not scanned for injected instructions; no explicit trust levels.
## Acceptance criteria
Documents/repos/READMEs/issues/PDFs/API+tools output are injection-scanned; explicit trust ladder (system>platform>workflow>user>model-plan>tools/retrieved); lower-trust content never gains higher authority by repetition.
